text_block_list.text:
Listen.
Just because those guys are crazy
awesome— 
doesn't mean you're any less yourself,
Ardan.
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text: Ace-san…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Course, if it were Ramonu,
she might've gone through it like a hot
knife through butter.
She'd be inside right about now,
a teacake in her hands,
lookin' all serene.

But listen up,
Ardan!
The one here right now—
the one who's been goin' against the grain
all this time is you!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've been watchin' ya. You make the time, 
and you put your whole back and more into
it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You said it,
didn't ya? That with all your might,
you'd catch up and snap at Maruzen,
even Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So don't doubt yourself.
Don't just assume you can't.
Give yourself a good look. Not at anybody else,
but you yourself!
… Ah—
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(… This feeling so reminiscent of frustration.
Whenever I compare my worthless self to my
perfect sister, it's always—)

—Mejiro Ramonu is in top shape.
She's as beautiful as ever. 
—Indeed. When she dances,
she shines just like a precious gemstone…
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
—The girl from earlier was feeling unwell
so she'd had to step in suddenly, but… 
—You wouldn't think that at all,
would you?
Look: She's utterly magnificent!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
(I remember. I was dragging myself around,
still heavy after barely recovering from a
fever,
watching it from the wings… the blurry shine
of the spotlight.)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Nee-sama… is so incredible. Such an elegant,
beautiful dance… she had the entire audience
lighting up…
text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure… for someone like me,
doing that is—
(Plink. Plink. Plink.)
She's really… so incredible…
text_block_list.name: Young Ardan

text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard… I try… I'll never… be
able to be like her…!
text_block_list.name: Young Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Because nee-sama is incredible… and… I'm…
not…!
text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Of course,
I was simply inferior to my sister's raw
talent. But… hey, little me. —
"What if it were me on that stage?")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(What would I have shown them?
What kind of brilliance? To know,
I have to dance.
I have to stand on stage with my own two
feet!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And as for my self-worth:
for as long as I myself haven't proven it
on a stage I belong on— it isn't decided!)

(Even if it seems like my sister is the
shining star of the show!
That alone won't be a reason to mar my
self-worth—!)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
… Thank you very much,
Ace-san. And— allow me to apologise.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Oh?… What'cha apologisin' for?
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
I had you come out all this way,
but… I'll be heading back inside tonight.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
I'm different from all of you… and from my
sister,
as well.
The reason being that my body is on the
frailer end.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro ARdan
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—I'd like to take a moment and recharge.
For the sake of shining with everyone else
from tomorrow onwards again.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hehe… you got it! I think that's the way to go,
too. 
'Aight, we should head back—

Oh, if it isn't Ardan and Ace! 
What're you up to inna… place like— achoo!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
C—C.B.-san?!
Were you outside wearing only that?!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Mmm～ see,
I was feeling super flushed after getting
out of the bath… and for a bit the snow lit
up by the night lights was really pretty.
So… achoo!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're a lost cause…! Oi, C.B.,
Ardan!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Come with me!
We're jumpin' back in the hot spring!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
I saw Ace and the others heading towards
the bath just earlier.
Mejiro Ardan was in accompaniment… she seemed
to be enjoying herself.
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
It appears that this hot spring trip has
indeed bore fruit… With this,
your objectives are achieved, are they not,
Maruzensky?
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Did I ever say that nudging along 
Ardan-chan was my only objective?
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text: Hm?… What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
Fufu～. Onee-san's got eagle eyes,
y'know? Rudolf.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaah-! 
Oryaaaagh!
text_block_list.name: C.B. & Ace

text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of look you had on your
face when you were watching those two… hm?
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rudolf.
Are you gonna be satisfied with the performance
as it is now? Really?
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace and Mr. C.B. might just 
leave you in the dust, you know?

Ardan-chan's all right on her own now,
you know? 
No matter what lies ahead—
she'll catch up.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
Even if you were to, say, shine even 
more brightly, more dazzlingly.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text: …What a predicament.
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
With Ramonu's absence,
it seems I've completely underestimated the
need to keep my guard up in regards to
jabs.
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I might not be at her level,
but I've got a taste for it too,
y'know?
The way you squirm about when poked.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But if we backtrack a little,
it's you who started it,
you know? You said it: "This time,
I'll bathe all Umamusume in the brilliance
of the Northern Lights," didn'tcha?

I got all excited too.
So I'm not letting you off the hook,
m'kay? Until you give me an answer,
you're not going to bed.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you really okay with things going
on this way? 
—Ms. "Emperor".
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
